notes: Receiving stock is simpler: quantity and cost come first, lot details fold away, and the same goods added twice on a supplier bill make two lots. The app asks before a second item with the same name splits your stock. Editing a lot now covers MRP and size, and a count change is a correction with a reason. The first-run example comes from your own trade, and Help & Guide opens from the menu, Settings and the ? on each main screen.
